trained_on: CafeBuddy item-level sales data (combined ~100,000 line items)

item_popularity_model.pkl.task: regression - predict units sold per item/daypart

how_to_use: Load a .pkl with joblib.load(). Each holds {'model','features','encoders'}. Encode inputs with the saved LabelEncoders, then call model.predict(). price_optimisation_table.csv opens directly in Excel. Full findings in reports/CafeBuddy_Insights_Report.txt.
